title: Quality management and traceability | Aquemi
meta: How we control quality: QMS, material traceability to heat number, orbital weld inspection, calibrated instruments and documented change control.
headline: Quality you can audit, from heat number to handover
lead: Our quality management system controls design, purchasing, fabrication and testing. Your auditors can follow any product-contact component from the mill certificate to the weld log to the FAT report.

body: Our quality management system (QMS) is [certified to ISO 9001:2015 by [registrar], certificate [number]] [or: built to ISO 9001:2015, with certification planned for [date]]. It is described in a quality manual and controlled procedures for design review, purchasing, fabrication, inspection, testing, nonconformance and corrective action.
We welcome supplier audits. Your quality unit can review procedures, records and the shop floor on [number] working days' notice.

items.d: Every product-contact component is received against an EN 10204 type 3.1 certificate and tracked by heat number to its weld and drawing.
Welds are made to qualified procedures by qualified welders, logged by number and shown on the weld map.
Visual and borescope inspection to ASME BPE acceptance criteria, with [percentage]% of product-contact welds borescoped and recorded.
Ra measured and recorded on product-contact surfaces; electropolished to Ra ≤ 0.5 µm on request.
Test and measuring instruments are calibrated on schedule against references traceable to national standards, with certificates in the package.
Once you approve a design document, every change is raised, assessed for impact, approved and recorded before work continues.
Deviations found in fabrication or testing are recorded, dispositioned and closed with a corrective and preventive action (CAPA) where needed.
Critical suppliers of tube, fittings, valves, membranes and instruments are approved and reviewed on a schedule.
Welding procedure specification and procedure qualification record approved; welder qualified to the procedure.
Tube and fitting heat numbers checked against certificates; coupons welded at the start of each shift or set-up.
Orbital weld made and numbered; weld parameters recorded.
Visual and borescope inspection against ASME BPE criteria; result entered in the weld log.
Weld log reconciled with the isometric drawing and the weld map before pressure testing.
